title: Transaction participants from operation meta are never recorded: participantsForMeta reads only the TransactionMeta v0 arm

target.versions_affected: v30.0.1 (6f7cff3) and main (01ba44a) with go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0 (range not established)

severity_basis: participantsForMeta returns early unless meta.Operations (the V0 arm) is set, so on V1-V4 meta accounts that appear only in operation meta (for example the maker of an offer crossed by a path payment) are never added to history_transaction_participants. The accounts still see the activity in /effects and /trades, and nothing is attributed to the wrong account (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: every account whose ledger entry changes in a successful transaction's operation meta is a transaction participant
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against Horizon. By hand at v30.0.1 on pubnet ledger 59501299: 7 successful transactions have accounts changed by operations that ParticipantsForTransaction does not list, for example GAUEEYOU… in 1c7352b4… (a path_payment_strict_send crossing its offer).

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's Go test at stellar-horizon v30.0.1 (6f7cff3) and main (01ba44a) on pubnet ledger 59501299 from the public data lake fails for 7 transactions; public Horizon does not list 1c7352b4… under the maker's /accounts/{id}/transactions.
evidence.expected_basis: On v0 meta Horizon recorded every account changed in operation meta as a participant; the V1-V4 arms carry the same operation changes (transaction.GetOperationChanges handles them).

reproduction.method: Re-run on 2026-11-18 at v30.0.1 (6f7cff3) with the issue's test on a local copy of pubnet ledger 59501299: 7 successful transactions with missing participants, including 1c7352b4….

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/stellar-horizon/issues/259; this record restates the public issue.
